phan_cach_ha_canh_lien_tiep_35L._mo_ta: Phan cach giua hai tau HA CANH lien tiep tren 35L, do tai thoi diem tau truoc cham banh: cu ly tau sau toi nguong 35L >= max(phan cach nhieu dong, phan cach giam sat ATS toi thieu, gian cach toi thieu ha canh lien tiep).
phan_cach_ha_canh_lien_tiep_35L.nguon: 011026_Du-thao-Manop-DN-PB03.docx (Du thao MANOP APP/TWR Da Nang), muc 'Phuong thuc kiem soat su dung tin hieu giam sat ATS' > 'Tieu chuan phan cach giam sat ATS': toi thieu 03 NM trong ban kinh 40 NM DAN den FL155; bang 'Truong hop co nhieu dong' (HEAVY-HEAVY 4, HEAVY-MEDIUM 5, MEDIUM-MEDIUM 3, MEDIUM-HEAVY 3 NM), ap dung khi hai tau dung cung duong CHC hoac 2 CHC song song cach nhau < 760 m. Trung khop ICAO Doc 4444 muc 8.7.3.4. Khoa 'X_sau_Y' = tau X bay SAU tau Y.
phan_cach_ha_canh_lien_tiep_35L.gian_cach_toi_thieu_nguon: 011026_Du-thao-Manop-DN-PB03.docx (Du thao MANOP APP/TWR Da Nang), muc 'Quy trinh dieu hanh tai APP/TWR Da Nang' > KSVKL APP Da Nang: 'Gian cach toi thieu giua cac tau bay ha canh lien tiep co the la 8NM (tau bay truoc ha canh tau bay sau con 8NM cach diem cham banh), neu co tau bay khoi hanh xen giua hai tau bay ha canh nay thi phai gia tang gian cach can thiet nay mot cach thich hop'.
phan_cach_ha_canh_lien_tiep_35L.gian_cach_toi_thieu_ly_do: Van ban viet 'CO THE la 8NM' -- kich ban HIEU la muc toi thieu bat buoc (cach hieu chat hon). Phan 'gia tang thich hop' khi co tau cat canh xen giua duoc dam bao bang dieu kien cat canh vs tau den (muc 4.2.1) + cham cang -> chay da + giai phong duong CHC.

giai_phong_truoc_huan_lenh_ha_canh.quy_tac: Tau ha canh truoc phai giai phong hoan toan duong CHC truoc khi tau sau toi 2 NM cach diem cham banh. Tau thoat ly 35L ra G4/G6 nam GIUA hai CHC (cach 35R ~107 m, vach dung cho 35R o 91 m, vach dung cho 35L o 123 m) nen than tau luon lan vach dung cho cua mot trong hai CHC; theo MANOP, khi co tau dung cho giua hai CHC truoc 35R thi KHONG su dung 35L -> 35L chi duoc coi la giai phong khi tau da CAT QUA HET 35R.
giai_phong_truoc_huan_lenh_ha_canh.nguon: 011026_Du-thao-Manop-DN-PB03.docx (Du thao MANOP APP/TWR Da Nang): 'TWR Da Nang cap huan lenh ha canh cho tau bay bay den truoc khi tau bay do den cu ly 02NM'; 'khong duoc cap huan lenh ha canh cho den khi tau bay ha canh truoc do da roi khoi duong CHC'; Phu luc 2 CHC song song muc 3: 'Khi co tau bay dung cho giua hai duong CHC (G1, G2, G4, G6) ... truoc duong CHC 35R/17L: ... han_che_duong_lan_E._mo_ta: Trong khi mot tau code D/E (kich ban ap ca code F) dang cat canh tren 35R -- tu luc bat dau chay da den khi roi khoi pham vi duong CHC -- chi tau code C tro xuong duoc o tren duong lan E. Khi tau code C cat canh: tau code E tro xuong duoc dung duong lan E (code F thi khong).
han_che_duong_lan_E.vung_duong_lan_E: Trong vong 30 m quanh tim duong lan E (doan 'E' trong taxiway_centerlines.geojson). KHONG tinh tau dang dung tai vi tri dung cho cat canh (trong vong 100 m quanh PREHOLD): do la vi tri dung cho thiet ke cua 35R.
han_che_duong_lan_E.vung_ly_do: MANOP noi 'duoc su dung duong lan E' ma khong dinh nghia pham vi. Kich ban hieu la tau dang LAN tren doan song song; tau dung cho tai diem cho E (cach tim 35R 112 m, ngoai vach dung cho thiet ke) khong tinh. Ap han che cho ca code F (MANOP khong nhac) la cach hieu chat hon.
han_che_duong_lan_E.ma_chu_nguon: ICAO Annex 14 Vol I Bang 1-1 (ma chu theo sai canh: C 24-<36 m, D 36-<52 m, E 52-<65 m, F 65-<80 m); sai canh theo tai lieu nha san xuat.
